sentences.text: The Tidal Current Tables work like the Tide Tables.
Table one gives daily times of slack water and maximum current at reference stations, with maximum flood and ebb speeds.
Table two gives corrections for subordinate stations: time differences for slack and maximum current, speed ratios for flood and ebb, and the true directions of flood and ebb.
Table three gives the current speed at any time between slack and maximum.

For example, if the reference station predicts a maximum flood of two knots at fourteen hundred, and a subordinate station has a time difference of minus twenty minutes and a flood ratio of point six, expect a maximum flood of one point two knots at thirteen forty.
